dialogues.speaker: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: I apologize, but imported Silk Flowers are currently out of stock due to the Sakoku Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Please let us know in advance if you want to place any custom orders. We will take note and start work as soon as the silk is back in stock.
